name: Should I consider power washing my house before painting, and why?

mainEntity.name: Should I consider power washing my house before painting, and why?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, power washing your house before painting is highly recommended. It effectively removes dirt, grime, mildew, and loose paint flakes that can prevent new paint from adhering properly. A clean, smooth surface is essential for maximum paint adhesion and a long-lasting finish. Skipping this step can lead to premature peeling and an uneven appearance, ultimately compromising the quality and durability of your exterior paint job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Power washing is recommended before painting to remove dirt, mildew, and loose paint. A clean surface ensures proper paint adhesion and a durable finish.
